registryNotes: All sixteen DOI records resolve through Crossref and Europe PMC with intended identity.
Crossref omits the AMP/CAP subtitle, which is present in raw JATS and Europe PMC; Jennings, 2017 and DOI agree.
Europe PMC fullTextXML failures were retained. Legal NCBI efetch supplied ABSOLUTE, AMP/CAP and Sanghvi bodies. Roth and Zehir efetch returned 429 and remain abstract-only here.

The incorrect Cancer.gov exon API route returned 404. The official Genetics/HealthProfessional route returned the exon identity and definition; this is a corrected lookup, not a source-access limitation.
